ChoYong WT2 Review

A hybrid receiver: real shortwave/AM/FM DSP reception plus 50,000+ station internet radio and a PTT walkie-talkie mode, all in one compact unit.

Check Price on Amazon

Specifications

BandsTEF6686-chip SW/MW/FM receiver, plus WiFi/4G internet radio (50,000+ streams) and 2W analog UHF PTT
ConnectivityWiFi (2.4GHz only — does not connect on 5GHz networks), Bluetooth 5.2 speaker output
Storage/PlaybackTF card slot for local audio playback
PowerReplaceable 5,000mAh battery
AppNo companion app on this model — all setup, including PTT channels, is done directly on the device

Pros

  • SW reception is genuinely good, especially paired with a small loop antenna
  • AM sensitivity is impressively strong for a hybrid device
  • FM reception is flawless
  • Internet radio is the standout feature — 50,000+ stations plus AI voice search makes browsing fast
  • Compact and easy to travel with
  • ChoYong customer service has been excellent to work with

Cons

  • Slightly small in hand — could be tricky with gloves or larger hands
  • WiFi/PTT only works on 2.4GHz networks, not 5GHz — easy to miss and worth knowing before setup
  • The UHF/PTT side is weak, though that's expected at 2W output
  • No companion app, so PTT channel setup is manual

Verdict

The WT2 isn't trying to be a dedicated DXing receiver — and it shouldn't be judged as one. What it is: a genuinely capable SW/AM/FM set that also happens to stream 50,000+ internet stations and double as a basic PTT radio. For a listener who wants shortwave plus the convenience of internet radio in one device, it earns its place. Battery life is solid (8/10), and ChoYong's support has been a pleasure to deal with. Rating: 4.5/5.
